Tea leaves are field crops unlocked at experience level 80.

They are exclusively used to make tea: green tea, milk tea, honey tea, lemon tea, orange tea, iced tea, mint tea, and apple ginger tea.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 650 coin.

Growing tea leaves

Tea leaves are grown in fields by planting another tea leaf (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 9 experience points, and takes 6 hours and 30 minutes to mature.

Selling tea leaves

  • Tea leaves can be bought or sold for a maximum price of 432 coin for 10 units.

Using tea leaves

Tea leaves are used to make the following products:


Green Tea Milk Tea Honey Tea

Boat orders

Boat orders ask for 7 to 11 tea leaves per crate, up to a total of 33 per boat.

Strategy tips

  • As recipes ask for one to five tea leaves. You need to keep large quantities of them in your silo, especially as they take a very long time to grow whereas tea is quick to brew in comparison.
  • Tea Leaves are one of the rarer crops in the Daily Dirt. You can hardly find these in the newspaper and they sell very quickly. Always remember to plant them overnight, just like tomatoes, asparagus, strawberries...
